note: Scripture follows the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, lug_bib — the lug text language_seed.py names), spliced by script. References come from the translators' reports (crib: the fr edition's notes, verse numbers corrected where the crib was off by one). A row is `mined` only when the chapter block holds a verbatim stretch of that OLCB verse (≥40 characters, or the whole verse if shorter; case, quote marks and apostrophe form ignored) AND the translator did not mark it self-rendered; everything else is `self_rendered`.

Augustine quotes his Latin Bible, mostly re-personed into address to God, so most references are self-rendered by design. Two quoted lines keep Augustine's Vulgate sense where the OLCB differs and are flagged for the reviewer: Psalm 89:10 (“humbledst the proud”; the OLCB names Rahab) in Book VII, and the Vulgate-shaped Psalm 139:6 (“Who can attain it?”) in Book X.

Translated by AI translators in 35 parts (≤4,200 words each), reconciled book-wide: God addressed as Ggwe, OLCB spelling baddayimooni, headings Essuula. Tag sequence identical to the English chapter by chapter. AI-translated; awaiting native review.
